v1.2.0 brings two things to the Marches and the heights: **a Mana Wyvern of your own**, and **the neighbouring kingdoms**. And near home, the **Royal Capital** rises.

## Your wyvern

### Eggs

Wyvern Eggs come from **roost hoards** (40% of roosts) and from **slain wild wyverns** (15%). Use an egg to set it down in front of you, then keep it in its element. While it is, it warms up; after **4 minutes** of warmth it hatches - bonded to whoever placed it. Look at the egg to see how it is doing.

| Egg | It needs |
|---|---|
| **Ember Wyvern Egg** | fire, a campfire, lava or magma within 4 blocks |
| **Frost Wyvern Egg** | snow or ice within 4 blocks |
| **Storm Wyvern Egg** | a lightning rod or copper within 4 blocks, or high ground (y 100 or above) |

### Growing up

Your wyvern grows while you are within 64 blocks of it (one growth point a second), faster when you feed it.

| Stage | Growth needed | Health | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Hatchling** | 0 | 24 | follows you about |
| **Juvenile** | 600 | 80 | fights beside you and breathes its element at monsters near you |
| **Adult** | 1800 | 200 | fights, and can be **saddled and ridden** |

| Food | Growth |
|---|---|
| beef | 40 |
| porkchop | 40 |
| mutton | 40 |
| chicken | 30 |
| rabbit | 30 |
| cod | 30 |
| salmon | 30 |
| cooked beef | 60 |
| cooked porkchop | 60 |
| cooked mutton | 60 |
| cooked chicken | 45 |
| cooked cod | 45 |
| cooked salmon | 45 |
| Mana Crystal | 90 |

Use food on your wyvern to feed it (it heals a little too). Only you can feed, saddle and ride it. If it falls, it **leaves an egg behind** - hatch it again.

### The Wyvern Whistle and the Saddle

* **Wyvern Whistle** (craft: a gold ingot over a Wyvern Scale over a bone): use it to switch your wyvern between **follow**, **stay** and **roam**; sneak-use it to **call** your wyvern to your side.
* **Wyvern Saddle** (craft: leather, a Wyvern Scale and an iron ingot; or buy one from the merchant or the Capital's quartermaster): use it on your fully grown wyvern.
* **Riding:** use your saddled wyvern to climb on. **Look to steer, hold forward to fly, jump to climb, sneak to step off** (you float down gently). While riding, **use the whistle to breathe** fire, frost or lightning where you look (every 4 seconds).

## The kingdoms of the Marches

Past the Forsaken Realm (about 2800 blocks from spawn), the Marches belong to the neighbouring kingdoms - the **Diamond Kingdom** to the west, the **Spade Kingdom** to the north and the **Heart Kingdom** to the east (the Southern Wilds belong to nobody).

| Kingdom | Its soldiers | Magic | Towards you | Their fort |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Diamond Kingdom** | Diamond Legionnaire | crystal and steel | hostile | Diamond Border Fort |
| **Spade Kingdom** | Spade Zealot | dark and gravity | hostile | Spade Citadel |
| **Heart Kingdom** | Heart Guardian | plant and spirit | **friendly** (they fight monsters with you) | Heart Sanctum |

* **Patrols:** in the Diamond and Spade Marches, a patrol of 3-4 soldiers may find you (sometimes led by a Champion). In the Heart Marches, Heart Guardians walk the woods and nod as they pass.
* **Border forts:** most Marches regions hold their kingdom's fort - a walled keep with four towers. Its soldiers wake as you come near; inside waits a **Diamond Commander** or a **Spade Inquisitor** (an Infernal with three traits). Defeat it to take the fort (**Fort Breaker**). Fort chests hold the kingdom's spoils, rolled treasure and sometimes a **Legion Prism** or **Zealot's Brand** relic.
* **Spoils of war:** Diamond Shards and Spade Sigils drop from soldiers and fill fort chests. The Royal Capital's **quartermaster** pays 25 doubloons for each - and a **star** for every ten you bring in.
* **The Heart Sanctum:** a spirit grove with a blossoming tree, friendly guardians and a **Heart Priestess** who sells the **Spirit Blossom** relic, Spirit Draughts, Sprite Dust and Heart Blooms - and answers an offering of **three Heart Blooms** with a rare relic. A **Spirit Draught** (craft: a Heart Bloom, a mana crystal and a glass bottle) gives Regeneration and +50% mana regeneration for 3 minutes.
* Defeating 25 Diamond or Spade soldiers earns **Border Warden**; the new mission *Hold the border* asks for six.

## The Royal Capital

Once per world, a walled town rises 150-230 blocks from the world spawn (in a direction the seed chooses, on the flattest ground it finds) as an explorer comes near. It has:

* a **gate** with green banners, **corner towers** and crenellated walls;
* a **plaza** with a fountain, a statue of light and a **Mana Waygate** ("The Royal Capital" - it joins your network when you arrive);
* the **Magic Knight HQ** with a Mission Board, a War Table and a Squad Banner, and the **quartermaster** of the war office;
* a **smithy** with a Magic Forge, an **inn** with its innkeeper (a bard), a **market** (a peddler, the Royal Cartographer and an apothecary), and houses;
* **Magic Knights** on guard (lost ones are replaced), shopkeepers who stay put.

Inside its walls **no monsters spawn and no ambushes come**. The first time you walk in it becomes **your home**: you wake there (unless you have slept in a bed elsewhere). The Atlas always shows the way to it. Reaching it earns **To the Capital**.
